questions.question: What is the name of the unified digital platform that the Indian government is using to integrate various agricultural schemes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishi Nivesh Portal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The government of India is integrating agricultural schemes under the unified Krishi Nivesh portal to streamline investments in the agriculture sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Purpose:** The Krishi Nivesh portal aims to streamline agri-investments by integrating multiple schemes from various ministries and state governments.
 
• **Investment Opportunities:** The portal categorizes investment opportunities based on geographical spread to unlock sectoral investment potential.
 
• **Schemes Covered:** The portal currently covers 17 flagship agri-sector schemes, such as Agriculture Infrastructure Fund and PM-KUSUM.
 
• **Departments Involved:** 14 central ministries and 9 state departments are involved in implementing agriculture schemes under this platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Scheme Integration:** The platform is designed to solve challenges such as fragmented information and slow loan disbursement in the agriculture sector.
 
• **Private Investment:** The government aims to boost private sector investment in agriculture to increase productivity and infrastructure.
 
• **Financial Allocation:** The government has allocated Rs 1.31 lakh crore for agriculture schemes in FY25.
 
• **Launch Details:** Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the portal, aiming to facilitate better coordination and promote agri-investments.

questions.question: Which countries will co-host the 2026 Rugby League World Cup?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia and Papua New Guinea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 2026 Rugby League World Cup is set to be co-hosted by **Australia** and **Papua New Guinea**.
 
• Australia has a rich rugby league heritage, being one of the strongest nations in the sport globally.
 
• Papua New Guinea is the only country where rugby league is the national sport, showcasing its popularity and significance.
 
• The decision to co-host the event with Papua New Guinea aims to promote the sport further in the Pacific region.
 
• Rugby League World Cups are held every four years, and the 2026 edition will follow the tournament hosted by France in 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rugby League World Cup:**

 
 
• The Rugby League World Cup is an international tournament first held in 1954, making it one of the oldest competitions in rugby.
 
• It is organized by the International Rugby League (IRL).
 
• The tournament features teams from across the globe, including Tier 1 nations and emerging rugby league nations.
 
• The format includes men's, women's, and wheelchair rugby league competitions.
 
 
 
• **Australia’s Rugby League Legacy:**
 
 
• Australia has won the Rugby League World Cup a record 11 times, solidifying its dominance in the sport.
 
• The National Rugby League (NRL) in Australia is one of the most competitive rugby league competitions in the world.
 
 
 
• **Papua New Guinea and Rugby League:**
 
 
• Rugby league is the most popular sport in Papua New Guinea, with a significant following at grassroots and professional levels.
 
• The Papua New Guinea national team, known as the Kumuls, is a competitive force in international rugby league.
 
 
 
• **Regional Development of Rugby League:**
 
 
• The co-hosting decision aims to boost rugby league infrastructure and participation in the Pacific region.
 
• It reflects the sport's commitment to expanding its reach beyond traditional strongholds.

questions.question: What is the new name of the India-England Test series? (June 2025)
questions.solution:

The India-England Test cricket series is now renamed the **Tendulkar-Anderson Trophy**, honoring Sachin Tendulkar and James Anderson.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recent inclusion of Ramsar Wetland Sites in India: (**as of June 2025**)

1. India has added two new wetlands—Khichan (Phalodi) and Menar (Udaipur), both in Rajasthan, raising the country’s total Ramsar sites to 91.

2. India holds the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

Which of the above statements is/are ***CORRECT***?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 2 only.

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct**: The two most recently designated Ramsar sites in India are Khichan (Phalodi) and Menar (Udaipur)** **in **Rajasthan (As of June 2025).**
 
• **Statement 2 is correct** as India holds the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

__
 
• The two most recently designated Ramsar sites in India are Gokul Jalashay and Udaipur Jheel in Bihar, both added in September 2025. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khichan (Phalodi):** A critical site for avian biodiversity, particularly for migratory Demoiselle cranes.
 
• **Menar (Udaipur):** Known for its community-led bird conservation efforts, often referred to as "Bird Village."
 
• **Ramsar Sites in India:** India now has the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia, demonstrating its strong commitment to wetland conservation and biodiversity protection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramsar Convention:** An international treaty adopted in 1971 to conserve and wisely use wetlands. India became a party to this convention in 1982.
 
• **Global Ranking:** India ranks third globally in terms of Ramsar sites, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

questions.question: How many digital Kisan Credit Cards had been created in India by March 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7.75 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• By March 2025, a total of **7.75 crore digital Kisan Credit Cards (KCC)** had been created in India to support farmers.
 
• The KCC scheme was introduced in 1998 by the Government of India in collaboration with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and NABARD to provide farmers with timely access to credit.
 
• The **digitalization of the Kisan Credit Card** has enabled easier access to credit and streamlined processes, reducing paperwork and time.
 
• The KCC initiative has been pivotal in providing **short-term credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and working capital** for allied agricultural activities.
 
• The government has been actively promoting the issuance of KCCs to small and marginal farmers, with a focus on ensuring financial inclusion in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme**

 
 
• Launched in 1998, the scheme aims to provide **adequate and timely credit support** to farmers for agricultural needs.
 
• It includes provisions for crop loans, working capital for farm maintenance, and allied activities like dairy and fisheries.
 
• Farmers can avail loans at subsidized interest rates under the scheme, with interest subventions provided by the government.
 
• The digital version of KCC ensures faster loan disbursement and real-time tracking of transactions.
 
 
 
• **Role of NABARD and RBI**
 
 
• The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) play key roles in implementing and monitoring the KCC scheme.
 
• NABARD provides guidelines to banks for issuing KCCs and ensures that the credit needs of farmers are met.
 
 
 
• **Financial Inclusion through KCC**
 
 
• Digital KCCs have significantly contributed to financial inclusion, particularly in rural India.
 
• They empower farmers by providing access to institutional credit, reducing dependence on informal sources like moneylenders.
 
 
 
• **Other Farmer-Centric Initiatives**
 
 
• **PM Kisan Samman Nidhi:** Provides direct income support of ₹6,000 annually to farmers.
 
• **Soil Health Card Scheme:** Provides farmers with information on soil nutrient status to improve crop productivity.
 
• **Fasal Bima Yojana:** Ensures crop insurance against natural calamities.

questions.question: Who is the current President of the International Criminal Court (ICC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Judge Tomoko Akane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The current President of the International Criminal Court (ICC) is Judge Tomoko Akane.
 
• She was elected to the position on March 11, 2024, for a three-year term. 
 
• Judge Rosario Salvatore Aitala was elected First Vice-President and Judge Reine Alapini-Gansou Second Vice-President.
 
• The Presidency coordinates with the other organs and seeks the concurrence of the Prosecutor on matters of mutual concern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ICC is the first permanent international criminal court and is governed by a treaty The Rome Statute. 
 
• ICC seeks to hold offenders accountable for their crimes and contribute to their prevention through international criminal justice.
 
• It looks into cases of the most serious crimes of concern to the world community, including genocide, war crimes, crimes against humanity, and crimes of aggression, and brings cases to trial when necessary.
 
• ICC is located in the Hague, Netherlands

questions.question: Who among the following won the gold medal in the women's high jump event at the National Games in February 2025?

• **Pooja Singh** won the **gold medal** in the **women's high jump event** at the **National Games held in February 2025.**
 
• The National Games are one of the premier sporting events in India, showcasing the talent and skills of athletes from various states and Union Territories.
 
• High jump is a track and field event in which athletes attempt to leap over a horizontal bar placed at measured heights without the aid of any equipment.
 
• **Pooja Singh** demonstrated exceptional **athletic skill, technique, and endurance** during the competition, earning her the top spot on the podium.
 
• The victory highlights her dedication and hard work as an athlete, contributing to her recognition in the national sports arena.
 
• The National Games provide a platform for athletes like **Pooja Singh** to gain exposure and prepare for international competitions such as the **Asian Games** and **Olympics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vithya Ramraj**__

 __
 
• **Vithya Ramraj** is an Indian athlete specializing in **hurdles and sprinting events.**
 
• She gained recognition for her performance in **national and international track events.**
 
• Although she did not win the high jump event at the National Games in February 2025, she continues to excel in her areas of expertise.
 
 
 
• **Abhinaya Shetty**__
 __
 
• **Abhinaya Shetty** is a promising athlete known for her participation in various **track and field events.**
 
• She is continuously improving her performance, aiming to make her mark in national competitions.
 
 
 
• **Swapna Barman**__
 
 
• **Swapna Barman** is an Indian track and field athlete specializing in **heptathlon.**
 
• She gained fame after winning a **gold medal at the Asian Games 2018.**
 
• Though she did not participate in or win the high jump event at the National Games in February 2025, her achievements continue to inspire young athletes.

questions.question: What was India’s total exports value in May 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**$71.12 billion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s export rose 2.77% in May at $71.12 billion; trade deficit narrowed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India’s **total exports** (goods + services) in **May 2025** rose **2.77%** to **$71.12 billion** (up from $69.20 billion).

 
 
• 
 
**Merchandise exports** fell slightly to **$38.73 billion** (from $39.59 billion).

 
 
• 
 
**Services exports** grew to **$32.39 billion** (from $29.61 billion).

 
 
• 
 
**Imports** in May 2025 were **$77.75 billion**, slightly lower than **$78.55 billion** in May 2024.

 
 
• 
 
The **trade deficit** narrowed to **$6.62 billion** in May 2025 (from $9.35 billion last May).

 
 
• 
 
**April–May 2025 total exports**: **$142.43 billion**, a **5.75%** increase.

 
 
• 
 
**Imports for April–May**: **$159.57 billion**, up **6.52%**.

 
 
• 
 
**Cumulative trade deficit (April–May 2025)**: **$17.14 billion**, slightly wider than **$15.12 billion** last year.
